messages:
Nina (partnerships): Heads up — drafting partner playbook for the edge runtime shim we promised Marketplace vendors. Need alignment on compatibility guarantees, deprecation windows, and partner comms. Thinking: 6mo notice + one-release fallback shim. Opinions?
Kai (eng-runtime): 6mo okay. Need to be explicit what the fallback covers. We can provide binary adapter for x86 and a trimmed arm64 shim, but no guarantees for custom quantized ops.
Alex (partner-eng): If partners will consume shims, we must provide signed artifacts and reproducible builds. Marketplace ingestion wants signed binaries and metadata.
Nina (partnerships): Agreed — signed releases. Proposed cadence: announce -> partner-only beta -> public 3mo deprecation notice -> final removal at 6mo. Map to support SLAs?
Sam (legal): Avoid language that creates long-term obligations beyond SOW. Use "grace period" and "best-effort compatibility." Add export-control checklist for on-prem customers.
Daniel (product): Rollout canaries: internal Dedicated canary, partner opt-in canary, 50% marketplace traffic, then full. Add automatic fallback to hosted variant if telemetry crosses thresholds.
Kai (eng-runtime): Telemetry gates: P95 token latency +30% or error rate >0.5% sustained for 10m triggers circuit to redirect calls to hosted variant. We'll supply a sample circuit-breaker config.
Alex (partner-eng): Partner checklist items: supported OS/arch, minimum runtime version, env vars, model formats, feature-flag to enable shim, sample canary YAML. Keep it copy-paste friendly.
Nina (partnerships): Action owners: Nina — comms + sync; Alex — partner checklist; Kai — telemetry/gate + test harness; Sam — legal review; Daniel — intro to marketplace ops.
Kai (eng-runtime): Quick question: version shim independently (semver) or tie to runtime release? I vote independent semver to avoid forcing upgrades for unrelated fixes.
Daniel (product): Independent semver and a compatibility matrix in the doc.
Alex (partner-eng): Offer both binary primary and SDK shim transitional. Mark SDK shim as unsupported for custom runtime patches.
Sam (legal): Addendum: customers opting into extended backcompat must sign an addendum before shim removal.
deploy-bot: deploy #edge-shim-prototype succeeded to staging — build 2026.03.22-87a1.
Nina (partnerships): Once staging stable, schedule 30m partner sync next week with 2-3 vendors. Agenda: overview, checklist, signing/provenance, canary timetable.
Alex (partner-eng): Pinged partners who historically requested notarized macOS binaries — will capture notes.
Nina (partnerships): I'll share the draft doc link here when ready. End of thread for now.
